THREE COMPLETE PALETTES — one interface.

The layout is settled and identical across all three rows: dashboard, CV builder, and phone. Only colour, type and shape change, so what you are judging is the palette, not a different design underneath.

Each row is a full set. Pick a row.

AUBERGINE & GOLD — DM Serif Display + Outfit · 18px radii
Deep plum #6B2D5C on a blush-white page #FAF5F7, antique gold #8F6212 for hints and badges, pine green for anything finished. Reads considered and slightly premium — a CV as something you'd be proud to hand over. Warmest of the three; the least 'software'.

FOREST & BUTTER — Newsreader + Public Sans · 14px radii
Deep forest #1E4D33 on warm oat #F5F3EA, butter-amber #A2700B for guidance. Calm, grown-up and quietly natural, and the easiest of the three on the eye for long writing sessions. Green doubles as the 'done' colour, so progress feels continuous rather than colour-coded.

NAVY & SUNSET — Archivo + Manrope · 12px radii
Deep navy #16264F on cool paper #F3F6FB with a burnt sunset #C24328 doing all the pointing. Tightest radii and the boldest type of the three — the most confident and modern, closest to what a hiring-tech product looks like, at the cost of some of the warmth in the other two.
